title: 3D workshop
error: This file can't be opened in the 3D workshop. You can still send your request: describe the colours you want in the form.
unavailable: The 3D workshop needs WebGL, which isn't available on this device or browser. Describe the colours you want in the form.
viewport: 3D view of your part: drag on the part to paint, elsewhere to rotate
clearConfirm: Clear all the paint on the part?

hints.orbit: Drag to rotate, right-click or Shift to pan, scroll wheel or pinch to zoom.
hints.brush: Drag on the part to paint. Shift: eraser. [ and ]: brush size.
hints.triangle: Paints each mesh facet you touch, without splitting it.
hints.fill: Hover to see the area, click to fill it.
hints.height: Click the part at the height you want: the colour changes from that layer.
hints.erase: Drag to give painted surfaces back the base colour.
hints.measure: Click two points on the part to measure the distance between them.
hints.lay: Click the face that should rest on the build plate.

brush.through: Paint through the part (hidden faces too)

fill.smoothHint: Fills the smooth surface, up to edges sharper than the chosen angle.
fill.colorHint: Repaints the whole connected area of the same colour.
fill.partHint: Fills the whole part you touch (a volume separate from the rest).

palette.title: Colours
palette.empty: Add at least one colour from our stock to paint.
palette.noOther: No other colour in stock in sufficient quantity.
palette.max: {max} colours at most: our printers load four spools.
palette.hint: The base (1) colours everything that isn't painted. Keys 1 to 4: pick the colour.
palette.fileOffer: Your file declares {count} colours (paint or parts), removed for now.

object.title: Size and orientation
object.fits: Fits on the build plate ({plate} × {plate} × {plate} mm).
object.tooBig: Larger than the build plate ({plate} mm): reduce the scale, turn the part, or ask us to split it into several pieces.
object.tiny: Your part is smaller than 6 mm: the file may be in centimetres or inches.
object.note: The workshop keeps your orientation and may adjust it for strength or supports.

summary.title: Summary
summary.changes: {count, plural, =0 {No filament change} one {≈ # filament change} other {≈ # filament changes}}
summary.note: Rough estimate (0.2 mm layers). Grouping colours by height means fewer changes, so a shorter print and less purge.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.tools: V view · B brush · T facet · F fill · H height · E eraser · M measure · L lay flat
shortcuts.brush: [ and ]: brush size · Shift + brush: eraser
shortcuts.undo: Ctrl + Z: undo · Ctrl + Y or Ctrl + Shift + Z: redo
shortcuts.view: 0: frame · scroll wheel: zoom towards the pointer
shortcuts.mouse: Right-click or pressed wheel: rotate, pan
shortcuts.touch: Touch: one finger paints or rotates, two fingers zoom and rotate

form.lead: Colours by area, size and orientation: prepare your part as you would in a slicer.
form.colors: {count, plural, one {# colour placed} other {# colours placed}}
form.attached: The colour project (a 3MF file ready for Bambu Studio) will be attached to your request.
form.multi: Several colours chosen: place them in the 3D workshop, or describe where each one goes.
form.fileColors: {count, plural, one {Colour taken from your file} other {# colours taken from your file}}: each took the closest shade in our stock. You can change them, or undo in the 3D workshop.
form.fileColorsMerged: Your file had more colours: the closest ones were merged (4 at most).
form.error: The 3D workshop can't open this file; you can still send your request.
form.unavailable: The 3D workshop needs WebGL, which isn't available here.
form.tooLarge: The colour project is larger than 30 MB: reduce the fine painting, or send the request without the workshop.
form.fileOffer: Your file declares {count} colours: the part is a single colour unless you use them (each will take the closest shade in our stock).

colors.oneHint: The whole piece in the same colour.
colors.severalHint: Up to {max}, placed by area on the piece.
colors.pickOne: Choose the colour of your piece.
colors.chosen: Your piece will be printed in {name}.
colors.slotMainHint: the whole piece, except areas in another colour
colors.needTwo: Choose at least two colours, then place them on the piece.
colors.notPlaced: Colours not placed yet. Open your piece and click the areas to colour (or describe it in your project).
colors.noWebgl: 3D placement isn't available on this device: describe in your project where each colour goes.
colors.place: Place the colours on the piece
colors.placed: {count, plural, one {# colour placed on the piece} other {# colours placed on the piece}}
colors.fromFile: Colours taken from your file, each in the closest shade from our stock.
colors.fromFileMerged: It had more than {max}: the closest ones were merged.

simple.title: Place the colours
simple.zoneHint: Click a surface: it takes the chosen colour.
simple.heightAboveHint: Click at the height you want: everything above takes the colour.
simple.heightBelowHint: Click at the height you want: everything below takes the colour.
simple.brushHint: Drag over the piece to paint freely.
simple.rotate: Drag beside the piece to turn it; scroll wheel or two fingers to zoom.
simple.onlyOne: Only one colour chosen: add another one to place it.
